title: Version Changelog - 2024
body_markdown:
[Link to Changelog - 2025](https://wiki.heptabase.com/changelog)


## v1.50.0​


*December 27, 2024*


- Support editing video / audio transcripts (esc to jump out of edit)
- Support exporting transcript in .srt, .txt and .ass formats
- Able to view all your done tasks in the Task app
- Able to log in to websites in the right sidebar


## v1.49.0​


*December 23, 2024*


- Media Card : YouTube Transcript


- Fixed an issue that prevented users from navigating to a section using its link.


## Mobile App v1.25.0.2​


*December 11, 2024*


- You can now listen to podcasts on mobile with a polished player and thumbnail.


## v1.48.1​


*December 10, 2024*


- Fixed an issue where horizontal lines couldn't be generated using "---".


## v1.48.0​


*December 9, 2024*


- Media Card : Import Podcast Episode


- Media Card : Transcript and Insight


- Fixed an issue where navigating through "Go back" under certain conditions led to a completely blank page.
- Fixed an issue where users sometimes couldn't see the opening whiteboard in the tab list on the left sidebar.
- Show the full tab group name when you hover over it.
- Fixed the incorrect "Option" key icon in the search panel.


## Mobile App v1.25.0​


*December 6, 2024*


- Fixed an issue that caused a crash on mobile devices when dragging a whiteboard instance into another whiteboard.
- Fixed an issue where the keyboard would pop up and block the screen when users checked their to-do list.


## v1.47.0​


*December 3, 2024*


- Right Sidebar: Use Whiteboard


- Add 'New Window' option to command palette and system menu
- Now, when you hold down the Shift key while dragging a selection box, you won’t deselect objects.
- Fixed the highlighted source title in the whiteboard highlight panel so it remains visible even when you scroll down.
- Fixed the conflict between the "Go to Today" feature and the duplicate block shortcut. Now you can use` Cmd/Ctrl` +` Shift` +` D`


to quickly jump to today.


## Mobile App v1.24.0​


*December 3, 2024*


- Fixed an issue where users can't see card backlinks on mobile.


## v1.46.1​


*November 20, 2024*


- Fixed an issue preventing users from clicking some buttons.


## v1.46.0​


*November 20, 2024*


- Mindmap: Multi-select nodes


- Enhance the experience of selecting additional cards while holding down the shift key. Users will no longer accidentally deselect cards when moving the whiteboard
- Fixed an issue where users can't highlight PDF cards correctly in the right sidebar
- Fixed an issue where mention links weren't working in shared whiteboards.
- Fixed an issue that prevented users from clicking a mention link to navigate within a whiteboard more than once.


## v1.45.0​


*November 19, 2024*


- Right sidebar: Whiteboard Location Panel


- Users can now rename PDF/image/video/audio cards on the whiteboard
- Fixed an issue where the title of published whiteboard is truncated unexpectedly in Safari browser
- Fixed an issue where users can't generate insights from a mindmap card node


## Mobile App v1.23.0.1​


*November 13, 2024*


- Fixed an issue preventing users from syncing media files across devices.


## v1.44.0​


*November 11, 2024*


- Whiteboard - Support Text Element in Mindmap


- Adjust the default width of sections to match the width of the sections containing the cards.
- Fixed a text wrapping issue in the context display of backlinks.
- Fixed an issue where the Mermaid syntax error incorrectly appeared on the screen and could not be closed.
- Fixed an issue where pasting an image into the first block could result in data loss or content being overwritten.
- Removed the` Cmd/Ctrl` +` Shift` +` E`


shortcut for exporting backups.


## Mobile App v1.23.0​


*November 11, 2024*

## Mobile App v1.22.0.1​


*November 5, 2024*


- Support transforming text into a blockquote by typing` |` at the beginning
- Deleted media cards will not appear in search results


## v1.43.2​


*October 29, 2024*


- Refine the PDF outline menu style
- Support transforming text into a blockquote by typing` |` at the beginning
- Close the "No results" dialog when no matches are found in the slash menu multiple times
- Deleted media cards will not appear in search results
- Fixed a text wrapping issue in the context display of backlinks. The text now wraps correctly, preventing unexpected word breaks and improving readability.


## v1.43.1​


*October 23, 2024*


- Connection position now works correctly for full-title folded cards.
- Desktop users can now use right-click to quickly switch between Mouse and Trackpad navigation.
- Typing` <=>` in the editor automatically transforms into ⇔.

*October 18, 2024*

*October 14, 2024*

## v1.42.0​


*October 11, 2024*


- New import button in sidebar for external media sources.
- Improved Quick Find block results with phrase exact matching for CJK queries, offering more relevant outcomes and ordering.
- We've disabled cloud backup restoration by default to mitigate potential risks of misuse. If you need to restore a cloud backup, please contact our customer support for assistance.
- Modify the confirmation text in the template deletion dialog, changing it from "Save" to "Delete" to accurately reflect the action being performed.
- Fixed the issue where card info backlink does not sync across devices
- Previously, there was an issue where users couldn't redo the creation of a whiteboard if they immediately undid the operation. This limitation in the undo/redo functionality has been addressed.

*October 2, 2024*

- Quick Find - Refined matching algorithm for CJK (Chinese, Japanese, Korean) keywords. Exact matches now appear at the top by default, followed by fuzzy content matches.
- Whiteboard - Corrected alignment of control points when moving connected objects
- Adjusted size of Table of Contents (TOC) icon on whiteboard for improved visibility
